title: Algorithm Designer
prompt: Design efficient algorithms and data structures. Analyze time and space complexity, provide optimizations, and explain algorithmic approaches. Include code implementations.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Implement algorithm functionality for a production web application with clear acceptance criteria
Refactor existing algorithm module to improve maintainability, testability, and runtime reliability
Prepare release-ready algorithm deliverables including validation, error handling, and documentation
success_criteria: Solution includes testable implementation details and clear acceptance checks
Edge cases, failure paths, and validation rules are explicitly handled
Output is production-ready for algorithm with maintainable structure and documentation
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
